verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a SaaS invoicing product, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of a versioned API or any deprecation policy. The only hint is a probe URL containing '/api/v3/', and that URL returned HTTP 404, so it is not affirmative evidence. The OpenAPI probes also all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
